name: FashionX
description: FashionX is a million-scale dataset exhaustively annotating visible fashion items within an outfit and organizing attributes from global to part-level. It supports multiple fashion tasks such as retrieval, recommendation, recognition, and dialogue, enabling unified vision-language learning for generalist fashion intelligence.
reputation: A large-scale fashion benchmark that is notable for unified multimodal fashion understanding across retrieval, recommendation, recognition, and dialogue.
notes: Dataset supports multi-task vision-language learning for fashion intelligence with exhaustive annotations and attribute organization.
